name: dripcore-discord-bot
description: DripCore all-in-one Discord bot with guild rosters, giveaways, permissions, reports, moderation, and AI guidance.

scripts.validate: node -e "require('./src/database/db'); const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); for(const dir of fs.readdirSync('./src/commands')){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(path.join('./src/commands',dir)).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js'))){const c=require(path.resolve('./src/commands',dir,f)); c.data.toJSON(); console.log('OK',dir+'/'+f)}}"
